company: ATLAS ENERGY FOR THE NINETIES PUBLIC NO 7 LTD

instruments.notes: Combined natural gas futures and options contracts held by the managing general partner (Atlas) covering approximately 23,000 dekatherms (Dth) of the Partnership's production; price is a combined average of $5.24 per Dth; volume unit is Dth (not converted). Designated as hedges; Partnership recognized losses of approximately $199,000 (2000) and $25,000 (1999) on settled contracts.
instruments.evidence_quote:
At December 31, 2000, Atlas had natural gas futures and options
         contracts covering approximately 23,000 dekatherms ("Dth") of the
         Partnership's gas production maturing February 2001 through August
         2001 at a combined average price of $5.24 per Dth.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Managing general partner Atlas may enter NYMEX/OTC natural gas futures and options solely for hedging price risk, not speculation; covers one-month periods up to eighteen months ahead; does not contract for positions it cannot offset with production.
